name: application-refund-request-panel
title: Refund Request Panel
description: Refund form with an order context line, reason select, prefilled/capped amount field, and an optional note, driven by a typed order/reason prop contract.
useWhen: Support or billing tooling needs a focused form for issuing a full or partial refund against a specific order.
The refund amount should default to the charge total but remain editable up to a maximum.
A reason code should be captured alongside an optional free-text note for records.
avoidWhen: The refund is always full-amount with no reason capture — a single confirm Dialog is simpler than a form.
You need to process the actual payment refund logic here — this is a form shell; wire the submit handler to your payment provider.
Multiple line items need individual partial refunds — build a line-item refund table instead of a single amount field.
responsiveBehavior: The panel is a single fixed-width card with intrinsic sizing; place it inside a dialog, drawer, or dedicated page to control its container width.
accessibility: Every field (reason, amount, note) has a visible, associated <label>, including the optional note field which is marked as such in its label text.
The amount input's currency symbol is a decorative prefix; the numeric value itself remains the accessible content of the field.
The maximum-refundable helper text sits directly below the amount field so screen readers encounter the constraint right after the input.

variants.title: Refund Request Panel
variants.description: Refund form with an order/charge summary line, a reason select, a currency-prefixed amount field with a max-refundable hint, an optional note, and cancel/issue actions.
accessibility: The optional Note label includes the word '(optional)' as visible text, not just a placeholder cue.

variants.title: Refund Request Panel (Dark)
variants.description: Refund request form adapted for dark surfaces with the same order-context, reason, amount, and note structure.
accessibility: Field labels, helper text, and input borders must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
